description: Search live federal grant opportunities on Grants.gov (posted by default). Returns hit count, agency, open/close dates, and assistance-listing (CFDA) numbers. Filter by agency code; sort by close date (soonest first); or restrict to grants closing within N days — sort/window apply to the fetched window and the response says when the window is narrower than the total hit count.

agency.description: Grants.gov agency code to require, e.g. 'EPA'

closing_within_days.description: Only grants whose close date falls within the next N days

sort.description: 'close_date' for soonest deadline first (default: Grants.gov order)

name: grants_search
